description: Open the page in headless Chromium (software WebGL 2) and report what a user would see go wrong: console and page errors (each with its likely cause and fix; shader errors point at your file and line), failed requests, no canvas or WebGL context, lost context, blank frames, the three revision, and a screenshot. `baseline` compares with an approved screenshot (created on first run) and reports the changed share with a diff image. `steps` interact first. When the frame is blank it also inspects the scene. Run it before you call a change done.

baseline.description: Baseline name; created on first run.

entry.description: HTML file in the folder (default index.html)

fixed_dt.description: deterministic clock: ms per frame (default 16.67); waits become frames

ignore.description: console messages containing this text are ignored

inspect.description: Also read the live scene graph and say why objects are not visible (done anyway when the frame is blank).

root.description: Folder to serve when the page needs files above its own folder (for example ../node_modules).

seed.description: deterministic clock: seed for Math.random; the clock is paused and moves one fixed frame at a time, so every run gives the same frames and pixels

steps.description: Interactions before the screenshot: click (selector or x,y), press (key), drag, wheel, wait, wait-for.

target.description: Folder with the page (index.html), or the http(s) URL of a running dev server.

wait.description: Milliseconds to let the scene run (default 2000).

name: three_check
title: Run a three.js page headless
